about: Welcome to my little corner of the internet. This place is for robots, books, games, stories, photographs, and whatever else I find worth keeping. The computer is old, but somebody is still home.

journal.title: System boot
journal.text: Robots After Dark.exe is online. The workshop lights are on, and the archive is still mostly empty. That seems like a good beginning.

junkyard.title: Workshop log #001
junkyard.text: Robotics projects and experiments will live here. Expect wires, wheels, questionable decisions and occasional success.

archive.title: The archive is open
archive.text: Books, comics, games and films worth remembering will be catalogued here.

stories.title: Unmapped worlds
stories.text: A shelf for fiction, characters, unfinished universes and things that might become stories.

photos.title: Photo drawer
photos.text: Cats, quiet places and fragments of ordinary life. Photos coming soon.

recycle.title: Nothing is ever really deleted
recycle.text: Odds and ends, curiosities and things that don't fit anywhere else.
